text:
nina: Heads-up — we discovered a signing gap during the runtime harden cutover: some ephemeral builder nodes couldn't access the KMS key due to a missing trust condition. planning an immediate small-window fix at 19:30 PT. can we do RBAC tweak + quick audit after?
ryan: I can help. what's the exact error? saw `AccessDenied: Caller not authorized for kms:Sign` in the cosign logs.
deepak: saw that too. CI is assuming role build-runner@ci-prod but the trust policy only allows the runner pool tag group; our ephemeral builders use tag group `builders-ephemeral` which was omitted. quick patch: add builders-ephemeral to trust, restrict to `sts:AssumeRole` and require source VPC condition.
sec-bot: Note: Any immediate RBAC changes must be recorded in ticket SEC-9001 and annotated with a justification. Auto-create audit event will appear in CloudTrail.
nina: I'll open SEC-9001 now with the justification "cutover sign failure — temporary trust change for ephemeral builders". we'll revert within 12 hours.
ryan: Suggest we also issue a short-lived one-off KMS key for the window instead of touching the existing key policy. create key with purpose SIGN_ONLY and keyRotation disabled, grant to build-runner ephemeral role, then rotate/disable after. Pros: less blast radius. Cons: extra key lifecycle steps.
deepak: That's doable. But cosign needs the public key to verify signatures later; ensure we upload public key to our provenance bucket and annotate image manifest with `x-sign-key: key-ephemeral-2026-03-24`.
nina: Ops checklist for 19:30PT window: 1) create ephemeral key (Asymmetric, ECDSA_P256), 2) grant kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey to role/ephemeral-builder, 3) update CI to use key uri, 4) run build+sign smoke, 5) verify with `cosign verify --key \nksm://.../key-ephemeral-2026-03-24 image:sha256:...`, 6) upload public key to s3://redwood-provenance/keys/2026-03-24.pem, 7) revert key policy or disable key.
ryan: I'll handle steps 1-3. deepak you can watch signing logs and validation. oncall: can you standby to open release-war-room if validation fails?
oncall: oncall: roger. If sign validation fails after step 5, abort and escalate to #release-war-room. Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/IMG-HOTPATCH-RB. Postmortem required if we use ephemeral key escape hatch.
sec-bot: Policy recommendation: ephemeral keys must be tagged with `ephemeral:true` and have TTL metadata in KMS tags. Also log `kms:Via` attribute in CloudTrail for later correlation.
deepak: small vuln note while we're doing this: image scan flagged `CVE-2026-1101 (libcrypto) — medium`. we rebuilt base with distro patch but the minimal image still pulls an older runtime dep. plan: add a build step to pin libcrypto to patched version and run container-sandbox tests.
nina: go ahead and open PR for the Dockerfile pin; mark `security/sprint-112` as owner. we'll block the cutover until the patched image passes the smoke tests.
ryan: also found that our deploy pipeline lacked an explicit cosign verify step for sidecar images. added a quick check in the pipeline template: `for img in $IMAGES; do cosign verify --key ksm://.../$PROD_KEY $img || exit 1; done` — I'll push as a hotfix to ci-templates.
deepak: note for auditors: capture both build logs and cosign attestations. we should push attestations to the attestation store (rekor or internal) and include attestation UUIDs in the image manifest under `provenance.attestations`.
nina: agreed. after the window we'll run an audit query: list CloudTrail events where eventName=Sign and look for principalArn matching build-runner@ci-prod and keyId equal to key-ephemeral-2026-03-24. capture screenshot and attach to SEC-9001.
sec-bot: Automated scan kicked off for `base-minimal:2026-03-24-hotfix`. status: scanning.
ryan: starting now to create ephemeral key and update CI env. pinging here when done. :construction:
deepak: I'll tail the cosign output and verify the `signature.bundle` contains the expected key id. if mismatch we abort.
nina: thanks — please keep messages short in this thread during window. we'll close SEC-9001 with the revert note after 12h.
oncall: oncall standing by at 19:25 PT.
